data.narrative:
Tomorrow.io is a Series E space & aerospace company that has raised $385M+ to date. Valuation analysis triangulates across a peer set of four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies (ICEYE, Impulse Space, Apex Space, Varda Space Industries) and public comparables including Rocket Lab, Planet Labs, and Lunaria.

Two applicable methods yield divergent signals. Stage-progression analysis, applying a 1.4x multiplier typical of Series E advancement to the $385M raised proxy, implies a $539M valuation. Peer-median anchoring across the four private comparables produces a $3.3B implied valuation; the peer set ranges from $1.6B (Varda) to $12.0B (ICEYE), with Impulse Space and Apex Space at $4.3B and $2.3B respectively. Public-comp P/S anchoring cannot be applied due to absence of target revenue disclosure, though the sector median trades at 24.6x across five public tickers.

The triangulated range spans $458M (conservative floor) to $3.8B (conservative ceiling), with a median of $1.9B. The wide spread reflects stage heterogeneity within the peer set and ICEYE's outsized valuation. Key uncertainties center on Tomorrow.io's revenue scale, customer concentration, and near-term path to profitability relative to peers. Further narrowing requires disclosure of top-line metrics or comparable transaction precedent at similar stages within weather intelligence or satellite data services.
